key_points: HSBC completed buyback of 48.7 million shares, indicating confidence in capital return.
Stock trades at EUR 17.78 after buyback completion, reflecting market absorption.
HSBC strategists remain bullish on equities amid rising interest rates, supporting near‑term outlook.
A broker reaffirmed its forecast for HSBC shares (1,640p target), signaling upside expectation.
Valuation metrics (GF Value $55.65 vs price $100.72) suggest the stock may be overvalued, posing a downside risk.
